title: Expose the host backdrop for Cantrip Pro themes
reason: OpenVSCode paints a fixed opaque background on the workbench root and flattens translucent title bars against it. Cantrip Pro themes already make the editor surfaces transparent, so a scoped higher-specificity rule must expose the embedding Tauri window's native vibrancy and blur without changing normal themes.
validation: Open a Code tab in Pro Mode and confirm the native window backdrop remains visible through the workbench root
removal: Remove after upstream OpenVSCode exposes a supported workbench-root transparency mechanism that Cantrip Pro themes can use.
